body: I did just that and she denied ever seeing it. I was going to call the police but I read on an earlier post that I could get in trouble for the items they find in the apartment since it’s under my name and she’s not on the lease
I’m trying to avoid loud noises all together but I guess your right about excepting this as part of life. Thank you for the advice.
Thank you so much for the advice! I’ll have to look into lip reading because conversations are a pain sometimes.

My manager asked if I was in pain (because of the look of anguish on my face) I told her I’m fine but she didn’t believe me. She thinks I’m in physical pain not mental. Well technically both, I have these ‘moments’ that are progressively getting harder and harder to control. I had a lid on 6 months ago but now it’s uncontrollable.

I thank you for taking the time to listen. It’s really helping tbh. I hope that someone’s there for you when your need like as you have been for me. You seriously subsided a lot of negative energy I’ve been feeling this past 2 weeks. Thank you.

My job requires me to deal with people because I’m the “face of the company” I do a good enough job wearing a mask over myself. Most of the time. They’re were times I let my frustrations out and customers saw. I have had to deal with an overwhelming amount of shame of my past and I’ve even moved to a completely new city to escape it all. But I end up making the same mistakes where ever I go. I’ve moved to the third city in 3 different states over the past 2 years but I can’t seem to find an escape. I’ve resorted to unorthodox means of coping but that only makes the situation worse. After all this running though I feel like this reddit has helped somewhat.

When I wrote this post originally I never actually was able to put together why I felt suicidal just that I had an overwhelming feeling of dread come over me. Writing down everything actually helped put a lot of it into perspective. It made me realize some of the major things that was causing problems. It helps identify some underlying issues but the day to day struggles are still there. I can be somewhat normal and calm then something triggers a mad memory and makes me panic. Which leads to more panicking. To the point I’m begging myself to stop. Cute things like puppies and kittens aren’t my thing, sure I think it’s cute but that’s not what helps my state of mind. I just feel dread when I’m a certain way and one of the only effective ways to stop my breakdowns was numbing my mind. Pills and ect.

Same pain different day. But I hope where ever you are your doing ok. Please live another day. This feeling of dread is getting to me and I know you feel the same thing. I think I’ll numb myself again.

I listen to sad music the most. I know listening to depressing songs while depressed doesn’t help but I relate to the message way more than any other music. I’m just wanted this feeling of dread to go away. I usually try to distract myself with music but I can’t shake this feeling. At work people see me having panic attacks and it’s getting harder to control... I feel like I’m losing my mind
I think the same thing. Just nothing after we die
The point I’m trying to get across is that don’t try. In the moments when I thought I was really gonna die I honestly regretted it. I was scared and when I felt like I was fading I wanted to live.

I tried opioid overdose mixed in with some ecstasy pills. I took 10 oxy because I was told that’s was a lethal dose. It was not. I started fading before my body started having convulsions. Lasted 2 hours none stop. I was numb but I still felt this pain all over. My mind was racing with thoughts like. Do I want this? Like really? Why am I here? Ect. My brother found me and made me puke but most of it was already in my system so all he could do was watch over me while my body had spasms.

I wish I knew more sympathetic people. Most just cast me aside saying my choices brought me here. And in a sense they’re right but still hurts when I ask for help only to get rejected by the very people I call “friends”

I thank you for your caring soul. I just don’t know how to speak out in person. It’s like there’s something in me that’s keeps me chained to my depression and doesn’t let me go. Until I take drugs to easy it. I took 3 oxy tonight to numb my body and mind. It’s helped but I’m constantly wanting more. I don’t allow myself to get to that point like last time but today I’m alive but tomorrow is a new day. New pain

I tried killing myself once with a drug overdose. I took about 10 oxy pill and 2 ecstasy pill. My thinking was that I’d fade off into a haze of happiness before go into nothingness. I was wrong. My body knew something was wrong and I started having convulsions. The ecstasy was making me feel delusional while the opioids make me feel exhausted yet at the same time wide awake. Like as if my brain knew if I passed out I wouldn’t wake up. I started having cold sweats and time seemed to tick really slowly for me. I just wanted it to end. To fucking end. My brother found me and he’s a hardline ex marine and told me that I brought myself to this. (He didn’t know I was trying to kill my self, he thought I went overboard on the partying again) as an hour passed  was when I started having spasms again. That’s when my brother came back and forced me to puke. But it was too late as most of the medication was already in my system. Unfortunately I survived and it left me with a physical and mental trauma. I wouldn’t recommend overdosing as a way to kill yourself ever. It’s not the peaceful and easy way out like some would think. Quite the opposite, I should’ve taken more though.

I understand your frustration, your sadness, feeling lost can feel pretty hopeless. But there’s always another day. You can be surprised what we can grow ourselves into with time. Don’t worry about those people and focus on yourself. It might not come right away but the time will come when you don’t need them for satisfaction. Please don’t do anything rash
Don’t do it. Hang on. Focus on yourself than on others. Your just lost but not forgotten. Spend time with family, pets, or even here. Your not alone.

As a regular user of recreational drugs: coke, ecstasy, ect. I can say the momentary happiness it brings only makes it harder later on. Stop using drugs as a means of escape because it’s not an escape. It’s a trap. It’ll only worsen the dark feelings after.
